review_correction.supersedes: Earlier coarse source review of this stable row, preserved in Git history.
review_correction.basis: Current Table 2 explicitly gives 105/1625/.../3050-ms sound-onset delays and -250/+3500-ms endpoints. Earlier values added 300 ms while still labelling sound onset. Current Methods does not establish uniform jitter or an online 100-1000-ms window; those were overstatements.
